aiDescriptions.n: SageMaker Catalog (separate product) drafts descriptions, business names and glossary terms with Bedrock for Glue and Redshift assets. Default quota 10K description runs a month.

bulkMetadata.n: COMMENT ON sets table, column and view comments in SQL. Not supported on external tables or late binding view columns. Q generative SQL also takes admin-uploaded JSON custom context.

autoClassify.n: No Redshift-native column classifier found. SageMaker Catalog (separate product) suggests glossary terms, including PII and PHI, from column names and schema at publish time.

sampleValues.n: Only in Amazon Quick Topics: authors set CellValueSynonyms by hand. No automatic value sampling found for Redshift.

queryHistory.n: Q generative SQL in Query Editor v2 can use other users' query history to improve SQL. Admin grants SYS:MONITOR. Not documented as suggesting joins or metrics.

lineage.n: SageMaker Catalog captures column-level lineage from Redshift, Glue and Spark (GA Dec 2024, OpenLineage compatible). Redshift is named as a source.

evals.n: Query Editor v2 has helpful and not helpful feedback with error categories. No eval set tooling. Curated question and SQL pairs go in custom context by hand.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Write table and column comments in Redshift with COMMENT ON, and add TableAnnotations, ColumnAnnotations and CuratedQueries to the Q generative SQL custom context JSON. To draft descriptions and business names, publish the tables to SageMaker Catalog and run the DataZone StartMetadataGenerationRun API with types BUSINESS_DESCRIPTIONS and BUSINESS_NAMES, then review the drafts. The API takes at most 2 types per call and one asset per call.

bulkSnippet.code:
# One asset per call. types accepts at most 2 values.
aws datazone start-metadata-generation-run \
  --domain-identifier $DOMAIN_ID \
  --owning-project-identifier $PROJECT_ID \
  --target type=ASSET,identifier=$ASSET_ID \
  --types BUSINESS_DESCRIPTIONS BUSINESS_NAMES

aiDescriptions.n: AI-assisted catalog content generation drafts asset summaries and descriptions and assigns tags. Needs AI Units and tenant enablement. Docs show no status label.

bulkMetadata.n: Export and import objects as CSN/JSON files, or use the datasphere CLI. Import can overwrite existing objects; import does not deploy.

autoClassify.n: Catalog auto-tags data products with Personal Data and Sensitive Personal Data. Generate Semantics sets column semantic types. Manual tagging of privacy tags is blocked.

sampleValues.n: No sample-value or literal-matching feature found. Natural language search filters object metadata only, not data values.

queryHistory.n: No query-history mining for joins, measures or examples in the docs read. Teams model these by hand.

lineage.n: Impact and Lineage Analysis supports column-level analysis, but only for tables, graphical and SQL views, and analytic models.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL eval tooling or feedback loop found. AI SQL view generation takes free-text prompts only.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Turn on SAP Business AI for the tenant, then use AI-assisted catalog content generation to draft summaries and descriptions for catalog assets. In the Data Builder, run Generate > Generate Semantics to set semantic usage, keys and column semantic types. For scripted edits, export objects to CSN/JSON, edit them, and import them back, or use the datasphere command line.

aiDescriptions.n: Copilot creates measure descriptions from the DAX formula in Power BI Desktop or web modeling (GA). Measures only. Needs Fabric capacity. semantic-link-labs can batch them.

bulkMetadata.n: Data agent Python SDK update_description sets table and column descriptions for a data agent (Preview, preview runtime). semantic-link-labs edits semantic models in code.

autoClassify.n: Microsoft Purview (separate product) classifies and labels. Fabric labels inherit at item level from Azure SQL or Synapse sources. Column-level classification not stated.

sampleValues.n: Instance value indexing (Preview runtime) searches semantic model column values to build DAX filters. Needs the Q&A setting, which retires in December 2026.

queryHistory.n: No query-history mining found. NL2SQL retrieves from your example query library, not from past queries.

lineage.n: Fabric lineage view is item level. Purview scans of Fabric items give item-level lineage, and sub-item lineage is not supported.

evals.n: Data agent evaluation SDK (Preview): ground truth DataFrame, evaluate_data_agent, results logging. evaluate_few_shots checks example SQL pairs. Feedback in Copilot (Preview) is read with list_feedback.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Add descriptions and synonyms to tables, columns and measures in the semantic model. Draft measure descriptions with Copilot or with generate_measure_descriptions in semantic-link-labs (needs F64 or higher), then review them. For SQL sources, set schema descriptions with update_description and add example queries with add_fewshots in the data agent SDK.

bulkSnippet.code:
from fabric.dataagent.client import FabricDataAgentManagement

agent = FabricDataAgentManagement("<data-agent-name>")
datasource = agent.get_datasources()[0]
table_path = ("Schemas", "dbo", "Tables", "adoptions")
datasource.update_description({
    table_path: "Contains one row for each pet adoption transaction."
})

aiDescriptions.n: GitHub Copilot in SSMS (separate product, SSMS 22.3+) writes database instructions as T-SQL you run to save as extended properties. No dedicated description generator.

bulkMetadata.n: sp_addextendedproperty writes MS_Description per table or column, value up to 7,500 bytes. Not allowed on memory-optimized tables.

autoClassify.n: Data Discovery and Classification recommends labels from column names only (SQL Server 2012+). You accept them in SSMS or with ADD SENSITIVITY CLASSIFICATION.

sampleValues.n: No value sampling or literal matching documented. Copilot in SSMS Agent mode can run queries you approve, but that is not a sampling feature.

queryHistory.n: No mining of query history for semantic suggestions documented. Query Store is not described as an AI input.

lineage.n: No built-in column lineage in SQL Server. Mirroring into Fabric gives item-level lineage only.

evals.n: No NL-to-SQL eval tooling for SQL Server or Azure SQL. Fabric data agent evaluation needs Fabric items.

vendors.enrichHowTo: Store business meaning as extended properties with sys.sp_addextendedproperty and the name MS_Description, and loop over a metadata table to write many. Update existing ones with sys.sp_updateextendedproperty. For GitHub Copilot in SSMS, store instructions as extended properties named AGENTS.md per object or CONSTITUTION.md per database. Run Data Discovery and Classification in SSMS to tag sensitive columns.

notes.text: Redshift has COMMENT ON for comments, and Amazon Q generative SQL in Query Editor v2 takes an admin-uploaded custom context with table and column annotations and curated queries. AI-drafted descriptions and glossary terms come from SageMaker Catalog, a separate product that supports Redshift assets.

notes.text: The DataZone StartMetadataGenerationRun API takes types BUSINESS_DESCRIPTIONS, BUSINESS_NAMES and BUSINESS_GLOSSARY_ASSOCIATIONS, at most 2 per call. The older single type field is still listed. Default quotas are 10K description runs, 50K business name runs and 10K glossary term runs a month.

The Dec 2024 GA announcement says lineage covers columns from Glue, Redshift and Spark. The July 2026 update for IAM-based domains names Spark jobs on EMR and Glue, Visual ETL and notebooks, and does not mention Redshift.
